title: Non-blocking follow-up from backend-market-scanner-followups review (PR #238)
description: Non-blocking finding from the pr-reviewer pass on PR #238 (the Retry-After header added to POST /api/ibkr/scanner/run's and POST /api/ibkr/breadth/snapshot's 429 responses), tracked here per CLAUDE.md's convention so it isn't lost once the PR merges.

checklist.step: The 429 `responses={}` entries for POST /api/ibkr/scanner/run and POST /api/ibkr/breadth/snapshot (backend/app/api/routers/ibkr.py) describe the new `Retry-After` header only in the `description` prose, not via a `headers` key in FastAPI's `responses={...}` dict. Because of that, the generated `frontend/src/api/types.ts` still types each 429 response's `headers` as the generic `{ [name: string]: unknown }` instead of a typed `Retry-After: string` field a frontend consumer could read without an unsafe cast. Add `headers: {"Retry-After": {"description": ..., "schema": {"type": "integer"}}}` to both routes' 429 response specs and regenerate backend/openapi.json + frontend/src/api/types.ts.
